title: ID0420841-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R6 170002001] Statistics are not reporting correctly with Sicharge D
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: I’m reaching out to check the possibility of extracting individual consumption
data for each vehicle at the WHEELTAINER site. Currently, statistics are not
reporting correctly through the Sicharge D chargers, which makes it difficult to
accurately allocate energy consumption per vehicle (from 1st January 2024 to 31
Dec 2024).
The site is equipped with two Sicharge D units:
• MP/R6 – S/N: 170002001
• MP/R6 – S/N: 170002081
Here are the vehicles involved along with their respective MAC addresses:
• Vehicle 1: 00-16-81-0E-D5-78
• Vehicle 2: 00-16-81-0E-D7-0C
• Vehicle 3: 00-16-81-0E-D6-50
We would like to know if it is possible to extract charging data (consumption,
duration, delivered energy, etc.) per vehicle in order to ensure accurate and
reliable tracking.
00:16:81:0E:D6:50
